propositions: A drainer killed between lock acquire and release leaks a 0-byte O_EXCL lock file permanently, with no owner stamp and no age-based staleness check.
Every subsequent drain attempt fails with FileExistsError, logs at INFO as skipped, and stops enrichment invisibly with no error signal or holder attribution.
The acquired lock file must carry a v2 owner stamp on create, and on FileExistsError collision must check staleness via wall-clock ceiling (1h) treating unrecognised stamps as reclaimable orphans.
A stale lock must be logged at WARNING with holder identity and age, unlinked, and the create retried exactly once; a second collision means another drainer won the race and the skip is honoured.
The doctor lock-health report must decode the drain lock stamp and report a real staleness verdict (stale-lock finding at exit 1 for dead holders, not-stale for live ones) instead of not-assessable.
